mapping.draft_py:
# M20 Chandra's Regulator (copy round B3, DESIGN_ATOM_ONTOLOGY §18)
_bf = Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY)
copy_trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=AbilityActivatedEvent(
        source=FAnd(children=(
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Chandra'),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Planeswalker'),
        )),
        kind=AbilityKind.LOYALTY,
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(steps=(
        OptionalEffect(inner=A(Verb.PAY, {
            'cost': Cost(parts=(CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=1)),)),
        })),
        Conditional(
            pred=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.MAY_DONE),
            then_effect=A(Verb.COPY, {
                'new_targets': True,
                'source': CopyOf(source=Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                    filter=FAnd(children=()),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                    referent='event',
                )),
            }),
        ),
    )),
)
draw = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(
        CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=1)),
        CostTap(),
        CostDiscard(target=Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FOr(children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Mountain'),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.COLOR_HAS, color='R'),
            )),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
        )),
    )),
    effect=A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
)
abilities = [copy_trigger, draw, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever you activate a loyalty ability of a Chandra planeswalker, you may pay {1}.
If you do, copy that ability.
You may choose new targets for the copy.
{1}, {T}, Discard a Mountain card or a red card: Draw a card.

mapping.notes: Was needs-atom (COPY had no executor). Copy round B3 (DESIGN_ATOM_ONTOLOGY §18): 'copy that ability' is COPY(CopyOf(event)) with no cards, the activated ability that activation put on the stack (copies.stack_object), its copy unpaid (no loyalty removed, CR 606.4, 707.10), new targets asked (707.10c). Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/M20/chandras_regulator_*.json.

clauses.clause: Whenever you activate a loyalty ability of a Chandra planeswalker, you may pay {1}.
clauses.evidence: The standard board has no Chandra planeswalker, so no stimulus can activate a loyalty ability (the card's only probe variants are its own cast and the generic stimuli: all 'same as on the board without the card'). Tree: TriggeredAbility(AbilityActivatedEvent(source Chandra planeswalker, kind LOYALTY, actor you)), effect OptionalEffect(PAY {1}). Packs (pass on the live tree and the packet's tree): A02_1/A02_2 (an activation of Chandra, Novice Pyromancer's [-2] offers the 'may pay' (fire/skip) and takes {1}: R 3 -> 2), A02_3 (declined: nothing paid), A02_4 (no mana: no offer at all), A02_5 (a non-Chandra planeswalker, Ajani, triggers nothing), A02_6 (the opponent's Chandra activating on their turn triggers nothing: 'you activate'), A02_7 (a no-target ability), A02_15 (the source died on its own cost), A02_16 (three players), A02_17 (the {1} is paid by tapping a Mountain, the way a game pays).

clauses.clause: If you do, copy that ability.
clauses.evidence: Tree: Conditional(MAY_DONE) over COPY(CopyOf(referent 'event')). Packs: A02_1 (paid: the copy and the original both resolve: the opponent takes 2 and the Ogre 2), A02_2 (both hit the Ogre 4/4: it dies), A02_3 / A02_4 (not paid or unpayable: no copy), A02_7 (the copy of a no-target ability adds RR again: R 4), A02_15 (copy of an ability whose source is gone, CR 113.7a), A02_16 (a referent 'that creature's controller' follows the copy's own target). The copy is put on the stack, not activated, CR 707.10, 606.4: Chandra's loyalty drops once (5 -> 3, A02_1) and there is no second offer to pay (the words are used up: an ask would raise).

clauses.clause: You may choose new targets for the copy.
clauses.evidence: Tree: COPY(new_targets=True). Packs: A02_1 (the copy's target changed from the Ogre to the opponent: 18 life, the Ogre keeps 2 damage), A02_2 (the copy keeps its target: Ogre dies), A02_16 (three players: Ogre One / its controller hit by the original, Ogre Two / its controller by the copy). CR 707.10c: each target may be kept or changed to any legal one.

clauses.clause: {1}, {T}, Discard a Mountain card or a red card: Draw a card.
clauses.evidence: Probe: '- ability [1] not activatable from battlefield: cost:discard:insufficient_candidates:0<1': the standard hand holds no red or Mountain card, so it never ran. Tree: cost {1}, CostDiscard(1 card of your hand, COLOR_HAS R or SUBTYPE Mountain), CostTap; effect DRAW 1. Packs: A02_8 (a red card), A02_9 (a Mountain card, which is not red), A02_10 (a red-green card is a red card): each taps the Regulator, pays {1} once (R 2 -> 1), discards the one chosen card and draws exactly one (the library's top card); A02_11 (the discard ask offers exactly the red card, the Mountain and the red-green card: not a Forest, not a white creature, not a colourless artifact); A02_12 (no qualifying card: not offered), A02_13 (no mana: not offered), A02_14 (a second activation in the turn: tapped, not offered), A02_18 (paid by tapping a Mountain).
